title: Members
description: Schema for data/members.yml. Each entry is one member institution, shown on /about/members/ and on its page in the CURIOSS Academic Map.

name.description: Institution name. Shown under the logo and used as its alt text.

logo.description: Path to the logo, under static/ (e.g. /images/about/logos/example.png).

url.description: Where the logo links to, usually the institution's OSPO.

mapPage.description: The institution's page in the CURIOSS Academic Map, as a path without .md (e.g. universities/example-university). The map shows the logo on that page.
